issues.description: Method Lecture.toString(): the problem statement and UML expect a toString() that returns a String and uses all attributes. The template contains a TODO for implementing toString() but does not provide a signature. The solution declares "@Override public Object toString()" (return type Object) which does not match the expected return type and is not a valid override of java.lang.Object.toString() (which returns String). The @Override annotation together with the Object return type will cause a compilation error and prevents students from using the provided solution as a correct reference.
